body: New PATCH /api/v1/apples/{id} (gpt2_fingerprint, model_fingerprint, astrology field set), async caller-side enrichment per TOWERPRINT.md design. Also fixed a real concurrency bug: syncAppleToGit's unguarded goroutine could race git commit/push across concurrent Apple creation with no retry on rejection -- root-caused a live data-integrity gap (9226 of 9908 Apples were missing from the APPLES git mirror; backfilled separately, APPLES commit 699bdd5). Added gitSyncMu + retry-with-rebase. Verified live end-to-end. commit IDUNA c9217df.
title: S147-02/03/05: Apple enrichment PATCH endpoint + git-sync race fix
